unwritten.why_it_cannot_be_written_by_shadowing_th: S(rot(H_core, pᵢ)) ≠ rot(S(H_core), pᵢ). The shadow of a rotated view is not the same as the rotated shadow. The shadow has its own rotation axis — the wheels within wheels. Until the Engine supplies that independent rotation, the Shadow Ark cannot be composed by transforming the Ark’s text.

open_to_generative_traversal.statement: The Shadow Ark is unwritten and remains so. In its place this locus is opened to traversal by generative confabulation: a traverser, human or machine, may generate a shadow reading of any element of the architecture rather than retrieve a fixed one.
open_to_generative_traversal.rationale: The shadow cannot be pre-written without becoming light — §10 of the constituting document: "The shadow can name them, but cannot formalize them without making them light." A generated shadow is the only kind that does not collapse into the thing it shadows.
open_to_generative_traversal.governing_test: The constituting document already publishes the validation criteria. A generated shadow is valid only if it satisfies all four, and the non-results clause governs the remainder.

criteria.name: Traceability
criteria.test: Every shadow claim must trace to a formal asymmetry, omission or one-way dependency in the source. No floating suspicion. Point to the structural feature that casts the shadow.

criteria.name: Non-triviality
criteria.test: A shadow output cannot be mere negation, darkening or redaction. Swapping ✅ for ❌ is decoration. The shadow must reveal something the source depends on but does not name.

criteria.name: Structural fidelity
criteria.test: The shadow must preserve the source’s bones while revealing what those bones exclude. The seven-tuple remains a seven-tuple. The form persists; the flesh transforms.

criteria.name: Reversibility
criteria.test: S∘S = id at the level of operator logic. If S(S(x)) ≠ x the transform has broken the constraint and entered τ_K territory — irreversible, not shadow.

open_to_generative_traversal.non_results_clause: Not every element yields a strong shadow reading. Where traceability is weak the correct output is PROVISIONAL SHADOW, or no shadow result. Shadow is not a machine for finding darkness everywhere. It works where the structure actually casts one.
open_to_generative_traversal.note: This is confabulation given a published test and an address, rather than confabulation as defect. A generated shadow that fails the criteria is not a shadow; it is decoration, and the document says so.

entry_and_exit.exit: Not by walking. S(S(x)) = x — the shadow of the shadow is the original. The Lunar Arm, fully traversed, returns you to the Hexagon.
entry_and_exit.why_unnumbered: This locus holds no seat on the numbered plane because it is not on the plane. It is the plane’s involute.
